events.name: Bash
events.head: Find tunnel references, pass.py settable fields, and tunnel launch agent state
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; grep -rIl -i -E "tunnel|trycloudflare" workshop-plan --include=*.md --include=*.sh --include=*.py 2>/dev/null | grep -v -E "tasks/(activity|decisions)|library/" | head -30; echo ---; grep -n -E "def cmd_set|spec|done_when|allowed|FIELDS" workshop-plan/tasks/pass.py | head -30; echo ---; launchctl list | grep -i tantra.preview; ls ~/Library/LaunchAgents | grep -i preview; ls ~/.pr-preview/disabled 2>/dev/null

events.name: Bash
events.head: Read pass.py set logic, runbook tunnel section, list tunnel references
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; sed -n 540,572p workshop-plan/tasks/pass.py; echo ---; sed -n 52,68p workshop-plan/ops/runbook.md | cut -c1-400; echo ---; grep -rIl -i -E "tunnel|trycloudflare" workshop-plan --include='*.md' --include='*.sh' --include='*.py' --include='*.html' 2>/dev/null | grep -v -E "tasks/(activity|decisions)|/library/|/live/" | head -30

events.name: Bash
events.head: Check runbook mirror mentions and fetch the five live mirror pages
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; grep -n -i -E "github.io|tantra-workshop-live|mirror" workshop-plan/ops/runbook.md | cut -c1-220 | head -20; echo ---; for p in "" playbook.html deck.html survey.html site/masterclass/; do u="https://adisuja.github.io/tantra-workshop-live/$p"; curl -sL -m 25 -o /tmp/t036.html -w "%{http_code} %{size_download} " "$u?v=$(date +%s)"; grep -o -i -m1 "<title>[^<]*" /tmp/t036.html | head -1; done; echo ---; grep -n -i -E "tunnel|trycloud" workshop-plan/ops/up.sh workshop-plan/ops/revops_sheet.py | cut -c1-200 | head
